staysWithHouse: Room robe unless a fresh example is expressly gifted

collections.title: Travel Cup & Reusable Bottle Gifts
collections.description: Fresh personal gift stock: an Albury travel coffee cup and reusable bottle, offered separately or together. A guest keeps the gifted items and their box; loaned household drinkware remains with the house.

collections.title: Guest Stationery Pack
collections.description: A complete take-home folio: A5 and pocket notebooks, pen, pencil, writing paper, envelopes, correspondence cards, two postcards and bookmark. The folio belongs to the guest; the room correspondence folder stays.

collections.title: Selected House Gifts
collections.description: Fresh boxed candle, mug, coaster set, larger notebook and waffle robe available as thoughtful selected gifts. This is a choice of gifts, not a compulsory bundle or used room equipment.

collections.title: Take-Home Food Hamper
collections.description: An example take-home food hamper: Seville marmalade, Hatfield bourbon and black cherry confiture, house mustard, rye crackers, shortbread and rosemary almonds. This gift basket and its contents belong to the recipient; selection and food handling suit the journey.

collections.title: Overnight Arrival Hamper
collections.description: Overnight welcome: Limestone Springs still and sparkling water in their original blue packaging; shortbread, chocolate sablés, rosemary almonds and seasonal fruit, with a complete guest stationery pack alongside. Food, drinks and stationery are for the guest; the lined wicker basket stays with the room.
